notes: Programs Pocket starts are now managed as whole groups: a Vault run cannot leave anything running behind it, a hung Codex process is killed so its conversation frees up, reminders are never announced twice by a slow mail server, and a reminder hook that hangs is ended after a minute.

Every store now checks a change whole and writes it before taking it up: a refused field or a full disk leaves projects, files, tasks, the Vault and Settings exactly as they were, the Vault file is synced to disk on every write, and a failed key rotation keeps the recovery key honest.

Browser logins are tighter: Pocket types a Vault value into typing and form-filling tools only, withholds screenshots from that browser once a value has been typed (a picture cannot be scrubbed), and scrubs values from object keys, numbers and split log lines too.

A Vault request now belongs to what it was asked for and to the session that asked: a run the owner allowed cannot be turned into a browser fill, nobody else on the box can continue it, one answer serves one use, and an item made owner-only or removed after the approval no longer releases.

Daemon secrets stay with the daemon: the mail password (inside POCKET_SMTP_URL) and the router key no longer reach agent turns, hooks or Vault runs, and a signed-out visitor is no longer told which modules are on.

Vault and Codex hardening: a bare null line from a Codex app-server no longer stops Pocket, the Vault scrubs the JSON spellings PHP and Python write, and locking the Vault while an agent waits answers the agent at once instead of leaving it hanging.
